subject.title: Feature: Inter-session progress streaming for sessions_send (ACP/long-running session support)

question: Should OpenClaw add caller-visible inter-session progress for sessions_send now, and should the contract be A2A event forwarding, an agent.events/sessions_subscribe read API, or part of the broader structured process-event design?
rationale: Current main proves the missing capability, but choosing the public event shape, buffering/replay semantics, and cross-session security boundary is a product/API decision that an automated fix should not make.

options.title: Fold into structured run events
options.body: Design one permission-checked run/process event contract that sessions_send, ACP sessions, Control UI, and future progress consumers can share.

options.title: Add a narrow sessions_subscribe API
options.body: Implement a bounded sessions_send-oriented subscription/read tool while documenting that broader process-event semantics remain future work.

options.title: Defer to existing final-only flow
options.body: Keep sessions_send as accepted/wait/final announce only and close or redirect progress needs to broader observability issues after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Fold into structured run events
recommendation.body: Design one permission-checked run/process event contract that sessions_send, ACP sessions, Control UI, and future progress consumers can share.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans sessions_send, Gateway RPC/event contracts, and security-sensitive event routing where this history points most strongly to steipete.
